notes: Smarter truck-inventory & Min/Max CSV import. It now reads the exports that used to fail silently — Dynamics GP reports (ItemNmbr, Qty On Hand, Min Order Point) with title lines above the header, tab/semicolon/pipe files, quoted thousands like "1,663", and messy header names. Before applying it shows the detected columns, and it warns if a full-truck upload has no quantity column (so it can't silently zero everyone's on-hand counts).
